statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Tail is elevated as technology-led futures weakness persists alongside oil above $107 and near-5% Treasury yields, while fresh granular evidence of repeated failed NQ retracements remains incomplete.
recommendation: The published policy mapping remains orange through the Europe-opening checkpoint. Further Tail escalation would require fresher evidence of persistent one-way NQ structure, shallow pullbacks, or repeated failed retracements rather than macro Stress alone.
headline: Technology-led futures weakness meets oil and rates pressure before Europe opens
body: Nasdaq futures were last verified about 1.3% lower versus roughly 0.5% for S&P futures as Asian technology shares weakened sharply. Brent traded above $107 and the U.S. 10-year yield was near 5%. These are multiple aligned amplifiers, but sufficiently fresh granular NQ pullback evidence is unavailable, keeping Tail in the upper 20s rather than a higher band.

lookbackSummary: Weekend hours held Tail at 19 despite extreme Stress until Globex reopened. Tail moved to WATCH at 22:00 UTC and then to elevated 25-28 as the technology gap, oil shock and rate pressure aligned, remaining orange through 05:00 UTC.
outlookSummary: The Europe open is the immediate checkpoint. Conditional Tail stays in the upper 20s if the technology discount persists, can ease toward WATCH with meaningful gap repair, and rises again around the U.S. cash open only if opening direction is reinforced by shallow or failed retracements.
